title: Electric Road Sweeper Truck DRS-2000HD
description: The DRS-2000HD Sweeper is a powerful, battery-operated cleaning machine designed for efficient dust control in large areas. With advanced sweeping technology, strong suction, and an eco-friendly design, it ensures maximum cleaning performance with minimal maintenance.
keyFeatures: High-Capacity Dust & Water Tanks – 2000L waste dust tank and 600L clear water tank for extended operations.
Wide Sweeping Coverage – 2400mm sweeping width for efficient area coverage.
Powerful Cleaning Performance – 24,000 m²/hour cleaning efficiency with 4 brushes.
Eco-Friendly Battery Operation – 30 kWh battery capacity with 8-10 hours running time.
Advanced Motor System – 5000W drive motor and 3000W vacuum motor for optimal performance.
Anti-Smog System – Yes, minimizes dust and improves air quality during sweeping.
Multi-Purpose Water Systems – In-built 130 Bar jet pressure washer and water cannon.
Safety Features – Alarm and front & rear warning lights for safe operation.
Spacious Two-Person Cabin – Comfortable operation for two crew members with Litter Picker.
